title: Preview - 1411 Taylor Street

1411 Taylor Street
Lampasas, TX 76550
$382,500, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,848 SF, MLS# 550358

Location, Location! Follow your heart to this delightful one in a kind home in the Hill Country. One of the great things about this pleasant home is it has a finished basement very rare for our neck of the woods.  It has 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, wood floors in family room, dining and eat-in kitchen. Cook up tasty treats on the all-white appliances that sets off a chef's kitchen. Entertain or simply relax on the comfortable covered patio. The discriminating buyer will appreciate such further features as an office/study on the front of the home, a laminate wood flooring, and ceramic tile flooring. Ceiling fans, car port, fence and storage building A hospitable air and an affordable jewel. You best hurry on over to preview, it won't last long.

2 full bath
